title: ScopedSignalFeaturesV1
description: Versioned, opaque normalized Signal observations for optional candidate ranking. Excludes editorial merit scores, author credibility ranks, and universal quality oracle scores.

availability_status.description: Explicit measurement availability state. Non-available states must produce a neutral 0.0 ranking delta.

snapshot_id.description: Optional immutable content/media snapshot identifier bound to these observations.

coverage_ratio.description: Fraction of requested scoped dimensions with available observations in [0, 1].

freshness_sec.description: Age in seconds since the bound snapshot was assessed.

evidence_support_tier.description: Source-relative alignment tier for supplied claims against attached sources.

consistency_tier.description: Internal consistency across headline, spoken update, and written article.

attention_pacing_score.description: D01 normalized [0, 1] sensory/cut intensity where higher values indicate rapid jolts or attention-bait pacing.

provenance_status.description: Technical or caller-declared provenance state; missing provenance is neutral.

independent_source_clusters.description: Count of distinct attached source clusters.

dimension_availability.description: Optional per-dimension availability overrides; any non-available dimension yields 0.0 delta.
